note: R10 exodus_01 enemies. 32px, PPU32, pivot16,1, right-facing parent flip, binary alpha. Chase/contact only; no walls, detection debuff or binding. New Codex script pixels; independent art review pending.
pivotSpace: pixel-edge coordinates, origin at the bottom-left corner of one frame cell, x right, y up
frameLayout: one horizontal strip per clip; frame i occupies x = i*cell.w .. (i+1)*cell.w, full height; no padding

flip.note: flip once on the actor's parent (or its single renderer), same rule as art 03 / R02-R07

alphaPolicies.binary: alpha is 0 or 255 only; RGB is 0 wherever alpha is 0

edgeMargin.why: 1px clear ring; grounded ex1/ex3 lowest opaque row 30. Floating ex2 keeps fixed ground anchor/pivot but its eye body bobs above the shadow.

references.brief: Bible-Survivor/docs/harness/r10-implementation-01.md: initial catalog and art ownership contract

assets.use: Heavy brick-backed four-legged construct with a low forward head; slow lumbering contact chase. Bricks stay on its back; no wall creation.
Floating singular eye with a dark asymmetric trailing membrane; quick contact chase. Body bobs above its stable pivot/shadow; no detection aura or debuff.
Broad empty animated armor with short decorative chain links attached to its chest and shoulders; slow high-HP contact chase. No human wearer, pharaonic regalia, reaching chain or binding effect.

notProduced.extra mechanics: No wall creation, detection debuff, binding, projectile, dash or new attack effect.
notProduced.hit/death: Existing shared enemy handling; no extra clips.
notProduced.shadow: Reuse art03 shadows unchanged; no new shadow PNG.

motifs.source: Exodus 1:8-22 oppression/labor, creatively adapted as nonhuman constructs, not literal biblical beings.
motifs.ex1: The burden of bricks made into a fictional brick-backed beast.
motifs.ex2: Surveillance made into a fictional floating eye.
motifs.ex3: Oppressive commands made into empty animated chain-decorated armor.
motifs.excluded: No biblical person, Egyptian/Israelite person, ethnicity, culture, God or judgment is demonized; no human face, skin, national symbol or royal costume.
